name: TalentScoutingPlayerEvaluator
tagline: A complete football recruitment department in one Power Apps control.
description: Scouting reports scored against position profiles, watch lists, a rule-driven shortlist pipeline, radar comparison and shortlist depth by position – for canvas and model-driven apps, with demo data out of the box.
features: Position-profile scouting reports (GK, DEF, MID, ATT)
Rating and position fit calculated from reports
Pipeline rules: report count, second scout, rating threshold, transfer budget
Drag-and-drop pipeline with reject reasons and undo
Shortlist depth vs target on a pitch
